stories.title: Judge orders Tennessee to preserve evidence in failed execution
stories.summary: Lawyers for Christa Pike, the woman who survived an execution in Tennessee, were in court Wednesday as she regained consciousness.

stories.title: Israelis return to rebuild on southern border with Gaza
stories.summary: Hundreds move back to the Kibbutz communities and southern Israeli cities that border Gaza. Many say they want to repopulate and help rebuild the region devastated by the Oct. 7, 2023, Hamas-led attack.

stories.title: Russia says there's no health emergency after a death at plague research institute
stories.summary: The World Health Organization says it wants more information on what caused the death of an employee at a Russian plague research lab. Russia says the woman died of pneumonia of unknown origin.

stories.title: At 100, Juneteenth's 'grandmother' Opal Lee vows to 'keep on walking' for social issues
stories.summary: Opal Lee, considered the grandmother of Juneteenth, turned 100 years old. She attended a ceremony at the site of the planned Juneteenth Museum in Fort Worth featuring former first lady Michelle Obama.

stories.title: Reflecting on soccer superstar Lionel Messi's unrivaled career
stories.summary: Lionel Messi played his last game for Argentina's national team on Tuesday. NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer reflects on his career and legacy with CBS Sports commentator Nico Cantor.

stories.title: Report says teen safety features on ChatGPT don't work
stories.summary: Common Sense Media tested ChatGPT for Teens and found that it still is not safe for young people.
